meta.title: Booking system: interactive demo
meta.description: Booking system demo with sample data from Colombia: availability by professional and location with public holidays, 5-step booking with a simulated deposit, business calendar by day and week, metrics, simulated WhatsApp reminders and .ics and CSV export.

shell.title: Booking system
shell.subtitle: How your customers book and how you see your calendar: availability calculated by professional and location, online deposit and WhatsApp reminders (simulated), plus the business calendar and metrics.

shell.footer: Fictitious businesses created for the demo (sample tax ID {nit}). Times are in Bogotá time.

how.title: How this demo works and what is simulated
real: Availability is calculated from each professional's or pitch's schedule, the service length plus preparation time, Colombian public holidays and existing bookings: appointments never overlap.
Your booking shows up in the business calendar, where you can confirm it, reschedule it, mark whether the customer showed up, cancel it, delete it and save notes.
Metrics (occupancy, no-shows, revenue, deposits, services and channels) are recalculated with every change.
Real downloads: the appointment or the calendar as an .ics file for Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar, and the booking list as CSV.
Your changes are saved in this browser for 7 days; «Reset data» goes back to the initial sample.
sim: Payments: the deposit with PSE, Nequi or card is a simulation; nothing is charged and no card details are requested. In your project it connects to the payment gateway you choose.
Messages: WhatsApp and email confirmations and reminders are previews; nothing is sent. In your project they connect to WhatsApp Business Platform and to your email.
Automatic sync with each professional's calendar (Google Calendar or Outlook) is set up during implementation; here you export and import the .ics file.
tour: Customer view: choose a location and a service; the calendar shows public holidays and fully booked days.
Pick a professional, date and time among the free slots (also try the Week view).
Fill in your details, accept the personal data authorization and pay the simulated deposit.
On the confirmation, download the .ics and simulate the reminder with the «Confirm» or «Reschedule» buttons.
Switch to Business view: your appointment is highlighted in the calendar; mark a past appointment as «No-show» and watch the metrics change.
